{{Quote|She is strong in the Force. Kyrisa is her name. She will be a powerful ally and serve the Emperor as I do.|Namman Cha|<ref name="LS" />}}
'''Kyrisa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir]], banished by her [[Coven/Legends|clan]] following a fierce battle for leadership.

==Biography==
===A witch of Dathomir===
{{Quote|Kyrisa shows promise with her ability to control the beasts of Dathomir.|[[Gethzerion]]|<ref name="LS" />}}
[[File:Gone_Forever.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Kyrisa is banished from Dathomir.]]
Born<ref name="Kyrisa" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GaTORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Dathomir]], Kyrisa was a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan of the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri
Witches]].<ref name="Kyrisa" /> Under the leadership of [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] [[Gethzerion]], she developed exceptional skill in [[Animal bond|controlling]] the minds of the local beasts, such as the enormous Dathomiri [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. Gethzerion saw promise in Kyrisa.<ref name="The Weak Mind">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=The Weak Mind Is Controlled}}</ref> When [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Namman Cha]], servant to the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was on a mission on Dathomir, he had sensed that Kyrisa and her ability were special, and determined that she could become a powerful ally to the Emperor.<ref name="Watching Witches">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Watching the Witches}}</ref>

====Attempt to take control====
Over time, Kyrisa became convinced that Gethzerion was too weak to lead the Nightsisters, and that under Kyrisa's control, the clan would be able to rule Dathomir. When she went to confront Gethzerion, Kyrisa openly declared her intentions to Gethzerion.<ref name="Fateful">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Fateful Encounter}}</ref> However, in their duel Gethzerion had beat Kyrisa, exiling her from the Nightsisters and sending her offworld in a small [[Starship/Legends|starship]], fearing that she was becoming too dangerous. Her ship would crash on the remote [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Gone Forever">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Gone Forever}}</ref>

===A new home on Hoth===
{{Quote|This planet is mine now! Hoth belongs to Kyrisa and her children.|Kyrisa|<ref name="LS" />}}
[[File:ANewHome.jpg|thumb|250px|right|On Hoth, Kyrisa soon began to dominate the local fauna.]]
Despite Hoth's hostile frozen [[Temperature/Legends|climate]], Kyrisa was able to survive by using local beast to gain the necessary knowledge of the planet. Away from her home planet and her clan, she relied on a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] with which she made a connection with for emotional and physical warmth.<ref name="Harmonious">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Harmonious Understanding}}</ref> Enraged at her banishment, Kyrisa vowed revenge against Clan Mother Gethzerion and the Nightsisters. Soon, she extended her mind control over entire packs of wampas<ref name="A New Home">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=A New Home}}</ref> and other local creatures such as [[Hoth hog/Legends|Hoth hogs]].<ref name="LS" /> Kyrisa found that Hoth could be a planet on which she could fully dominate. Experiencing a rebirth, she came to treat the cold planet as her new home.<ref name="A New Home" /> Eventually the entirety of the wildlife in the area Kyrisa resided in came under her command. She even experimented in the genetic engineering to create unnatural overgrown beasts of gargantuan proportions, such as the over-sized Hoth hog [[Maraki]]<ref name="Maraki">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Maraki}}</ref> or the giant wampa named [[Unkajo/Legends|Unkajo]].<ref name="Unkajo">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Unkajo}}</ref>

However, Kyrisa's departure from Dathomir would not go unnoticed by other forces of the galactic scale: Namman Cha still intended to recruit the Nightsister into the service of the Emperor. He learned that her starship had crashed on Hoth and set out on the mission to find her. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] leader [[Cronal|Blackhole]] also was interested in the Nightsister, having several ideas for the use of beast mastery in the espionage, he set a small detachment of ISB agents led by [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jeffren Brek]] to aid Cha in his search.<ref name="DS" /> Cha's involvement had also became known to his old enemy [[Rachi Sitra]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Sitra learned from the Dathomiri Witches from the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of the danger Kyrisa represented and, determined not to let her be found by the Empire, traveled to Hoth with a mission to find her first.<ref name="LS" />

[[File:Kyrisa_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|250px|left|Kyrisa, wielding her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in battle]]
Around the same time, the Alliance to Restore the Republic had discovered the distant planet Hoth and established a small outpost there, evaluating the potential of building a larger base.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Building the Base">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Building the Base}}</ref> Kyrisa began using her pack of minions to wreak havoc on the Alliance forces, stealing supplies necessary to help her return home to enact her revenge. At the same time the multiple parties looking for the Nightsister on the planet began encountering resistance from Kyrisa's beasts. A single Rebel looking for shelter in an ice-storm stumbled onto a cavern full of her Hoth hogs and was forced to defend himself, killing all of the beasts, including Kyrisa's beloved Maraki. Sensing his [[Death/Legends|death]], Kyrisa rushed to the cave, accompanied by two Wampas, and confronted the Rebel who was about to leave. She ignored his words that he was forced to defend himself and blamed him of murdering her "children." She ordered her menagerie to attack, but the well-armed Rebel managed to slay most of the beasts. Seeing the battle turned against her, Kyrisa jumped on the back of a hog to make an escape.<ref name="LS" />

Enraged by the loss of one of her pets, Kyrisa soon found another one of her creations, the giant wampa [[Unkajo/Legends|Unkajo]] slain by a squad of Imperial soldiers. Furious, she directed her pets at the Imperials she saw as murderers. However, the trained soldiers managed to hold the beast off and one even managed to get to Kyrisa and knock her down. She got herself up with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to see that many more of her pets have been slain, and the battle was going against her. The remaining creatures formed a line to cover her retreat and the Nightsister had escaped into the blowing snow.<ref name="DS" /> However, the Dark Jedi Namman Cha eventually managed to track her down by following her beasts and, after a fierce [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] clash, was able to persuade her to join him.<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-Reptomammal Battle">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Reptomammal Battle}}</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Kyrisa-TNR.jpg|thumb|250px|right|Kyrisa with one of her wampa minions]]
{{Quote|Genetic engineering&ndash; that's another of Kyrisa's specialties.|[[Jeffren Brek]]|<ref name="LS" />}}
Kyrisa was a skilled Nightsister and had fully mastered the power of [[Animal bond|Animal friendship]]. While initially she, just like other Dathomiri Witches, only established a bond with her rancor, eventually she could exert and maintain her influence over multiple creatures simultaneously. The creatures remained constantly over her control, even at significant distance, and obeyed her commands, both spoken and mental. Her ability attracted attention of both Gethzerion and Namman Cha, who saw Kyrisa as a powerful ally, and [[Augwynne Djo]] and Rachi Sitra, who saw her as a great danger. While on Hoth, Kyrisa had employed not only the animal friendship, but her skill in the genetic engineering as well, by creating creatures far larger compared to their natural size. She also was one of the many Nightsisters who, in spite of their tribe's rather primitive homeland, wielded a lightsaber.

==Behind the scenes==
Kyrisa was created by the developer team of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' as the pivotal story element of ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'', the sixth of the game's expansions. She confronts the player in the both light side and the dark side campaign scenarios, while her story is told through various cards within the set. She was later added to the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' in December [[2010]], as part of the game's "[[:w:c:swg:Game Update 19|Game Update 19]]".
